questions.prompt: 2376 is divisible by which of these? Choose all that apply.
questions.explain: Last two digits 76 ÷ 4 ✓; digit sum 18 ✓ for 9; alternating sum 6 − 7 + 3 − 2 = 0 ✓ for 11. It doesn't end in 0 or 5.

questions.prompt: Find the missing digit so that the number is divisible by 9.
questions.explain: 5 + 2 + 4 = 11. The next multiple of 9 is 18, so the missing digit is 7.

questions.prompt: Which of these numbers can NOT be written as a sum of two or more consecutive positive numbers?
The sum of any three consecutive whole numbers is always…
What is the remainder when 1000 is divided by 9?
questions.explain: The digit sum of 1000 is 1, so the remainder is 1 (1000 = 999 + 1).

questions.prompt: Prove that the sum of any three consecutive whole numbers is divisible by 3.
questions.modelAnswer: Call the middle number n. The three numbers are n − 1, n and n + 1. Their sum is (n − 1) + n + (n + 1) = 3n, which is 3 times a whole number, so it is always divisible by 3. Example: 7 + 8 + 9 = 24 = 3 × 8.

questions.prompt: What kind of number do you always get when you multiply two odd numbers?
questions.explain: Odd × odd has no factor of 2, so it is always odd (e.g. 3 × 5 = 15).
